name: Beacon Tower
description: The Beacon Tower is a structure used to detect players and certain structures within its radius and display them on the map. Beacons can link with a friendly Fortress Keep or other Beacon Towers to create a chain. The detection range of each beacon varies based on relative altitude within an area, with greater coverage from the sides of hills and mountains. The altitude indicators observed before placing the beacon are normal, high, very high, and highest depending where you are building the beacon. If the beacon is fueled and an enemy appears within its own or linked radius, the beacon tower will visually become lit.

name: Dirt Path
description: The Dirt Path is a road surface that will speed up any player running over it by 20%.

name: Gravel Road
description: The Gravel Road is a road surface that will speed up any player running over it by 25%.

name: Repair Bench
description: The Repair Bench is a structure that can be used to repair damaged weapons, tools or armours by consuming Copper Nails. It always costs 1 nail to fully repair an item.

name: Sign Post
description: A Sign Post is a structure that can be built almost anywhere within the world to create semi-persistent text messages. Signs can be upvoted or downvoted to increase or decrease its lifespan. Signs have a 200 message character limit.

name: Standing Torch
description: The Standing Torch is a light producing structure that needs fuel to function.

name: Storage Chest
description: The Storage Chest is a small dedicated storage structure.

name: Temple
description: The Temple is a late game victory condition structure. It can be built no earlier than 4 Days after the war has started, with currently 2 being required to start the condition and then kept alive for 48 hours. Temples will be visible on the map for everyone once built.

name: Tent
description: The Tent is a structure that is built to increase avatar recovery time. Base recovery is 10 hours and with each tent built increases avatar recovery speed by 5%, with maximum of 20 tents reaching 100% (5 hours), effectively halving the time required for full recovery.

name: Homestead Keystone T1
description: The Homestead Keystone is the center of a homestead and can be claimed by a house. At Tiers 2 and 3, a destroyed keystone collapses into an indestructible husk that despawns after 24 hours unless it is repaired. Keystones without a roof or any pledges will rapidly decay, potentially within only a few hours, even when upkeep Silver Gold.png is available.

name: Armour Rack

name: Gate (Homestead)
description: The Gate is simple gate which can be used with Makeshift Walls inside a Homestead Keystone. It can be opened and closed by pressing Keyboard V while in range of the gate. Battering Rams have a unique feature when attacking Gates that allows it to breach and open a gate before it's destroyed. Once a gate has been breached it will be permanently stuck open until it has been repaired. The chance for a gate to breach depends on its tier, and its health each time the gate is rammed.

name: Makeshift Wall
description: The Makeshift Wall is a basic wall for defending your homesteads, it connects well with the Gate (Homestead).

name: Mantlet
description: The Mantlet is a temporary defensive structure that can be built to provide cover.

name: Stockade
description: The Stockade is a defensive spike structure that will damage players or animals that get too close, dealing 40 Piercing damage per second.

name: Tower
description: The Tower is a structure.

name: Weapon Stockpile
description: The Weapon Stockpile is a storage structure for holding weapons, tools or ammunition.

name: Aqueduct Pump
description: The Aqueduct Pump is a water structure used to pump water from a river into an aqueduct system. Aqueducts cannot be built without water connection.

name: Aqueduct Slope - Gentle
description: The Aqueduct Slope - Gentle is a water structure used to transport water from a river along a aqueduct system. Aqueducts cannot be built without water connection.

name: Aqueduct Slope - Steep
description: The Aqueduct Slope - Steep is a water structure used to transport water from a river along a aqueduct system. Aqueducts cannot be built without water connection.

name: Aqueduct Straight
description: The Aqueduct Straight is a water structure used to transport water from a river along a aqueduct system. Aqueducts cannot be built without water connection.

name: Canal
description: A Canal is a structure for distributing water from an aqueduct around a Town or Homestead. It can be used to attach to a Water Wheel or Canal Storage.

name: Canal Storage
description: The Canal Storage is a structure used in an aqueduct system for storing water. It will drain water from the system, storing Water Bucket in its inventory. The speed at which Water Bucket are filled is based on the number of other canal storages attached to the system. It has a minimum time of 15 seconds per water, but this can extend into 5+ minutes per water with large amounts of attached canal storage.

name: Heating Vat
description: To craft using the heating vat you need three types of items. The necessary input for the recipe, the fuel which will set the vats heat, and the Water Bucket used for boiling. A Bellow can be attached to boost the heat input of the fuel by 50%, with each boilable item having an optimal target temprature for best Quality.

name: Shallow Well
description: The Shallow Well is a structure used to get water. It will create 1 Water Bucket every 45 seconds.

name: Deep Well
description: The Shallow Well is a structure used to get water. It will create 1 Water Bucket every 45 seconds.

name: Water Wheel
description: The Water Wheel is a water structure used to generate power fed from a Canal attached to an aqueduct system.

name: Anvil
description: The Anvil is a heated smithing structure used to shape Bronze Ingot (Heated) and Iron Ingot (Heated) into blades.

name: Bellow
description: The Bellow is an industrial structure used to attach to a Forge or Heating Vat to increase heat.

name: Farm Fence
description: The Farm Fence is a structure useful against rabbits and losing animals.

name: Farm Gate
description: The Farm Gate is a structure.

name: Food Trough
description: The Food Trough is a husbandry structure used for raising Horse Foal or Donkey Foal . NOTE: Adult animals will not eat food from the Food Trough, meaning they will starve if not placed inside a Stable , or fed manually.

name: Forge
description: The Forge is a smithing structure used for heating ingots or blades. By default its only able to heat items up to 50% heat, with the remaining 50% be accessed by building an attached Bellow .

name: Furnace
description: The Furnace is a refinement structure used for refining fragments into ingots.

name: Grain Mill
description: The Grain Mill is a structure used for milling resources. Players can manually operate the mill via a handcrank to grind ingredients, or attach a Powered Handcrank Adapter connected to a power source for automation. The coarseness of ground ingredients can be controlled by pushing a lever at the side of the structure. The correct coarseness determines the final quality of the outputted materials.

name: Hen House T1
description: The Hen House is a animal husbandry structure used for feeding Chicken with Chicken Feed and collecting their Chicken Egg and Feathers . Up to 8 chickens will eat at midnight each day if enough feed is available.

name: Hen House T2
description: The Hen House is a animal husbandry structure used for feeding Chicken with Chicken Feed and collecting their Chicken Egg and Feathers . Up to 20 chickens will eat at midnight each day if enough feed is available.

name: Mining Platform
description: The Mining Platform, like the Mining Stairs , is a framing structure used in the underworld for accessing resource chunks. They can only be built in close proximity to underworld cube mines.

name: Mining Stairs
description: The Mining Stairs, like the Mining Platform , is a framing structure used in the underworld for accessing resource chunks. They can only be built in close proximity to underworld cube mines.

name: Power Connection Gear
description: The Power Connection Gear is a power structure used with Power Connection Rope to carry mechanical energy to other rope power structures.

name: Power Connection Rope
description: The Power Connection Rope is a power structure used with Power Connection Gear to carry mechanical energy to other rope power structures.

name: Power Mill
description: The Power Mill is a structure for power generation much like the Water Wheel , and Wind Mill . It's a manual push wheel that can be used by players, Horse or Donkey . In order for a Horse or Donkey to be attached they must have a Mill Harness attachment.

name: Powered Handcrank Adapter
description: The Powered Handcrank Adapter is a power structure that's used to connect the Grain Mill to a power system via Power Connection Rope .

name: Powered Saw Mill
description: The Powered Saw Mill is a workshop structure that attaches to the Sawbuck . It's a powered structure used to automatically saw logs attached to the sawbuck.

name: Quenching Station
description: The Quenching Station is a smithing structure used for cooling heated ingots and blades. It consumes one Water Bucket for each item quenched.

name: Sawbuck
description: The Sawbuck is a structure used for processing logs into different resources. Logs are processed via hitting with an axe or use of an attached Powered Saw Mill .

name: Smashing Plate
description: The Smashing Plate is a structure used for breaking down rocks and minerals. Items are processed via hitting with a hammer or use of an attached Stamp Mill .

name: Stable
description: A Stable is a structure used for feeding and breeding Horse Foal or Donkey Foal . Each stable can hold up to 3 animals. Animals in the stable are automatically fed from available Equine Feed when their satiety drops below 65%. Animals in the stable can be bred by having two of the same kind of animal, Equine Feed. Water Bucket, and an empty animal slot within the stable. If these conditions are met breeding can take 1-4 hours for Horse and 2-5 hours for Donkey.

name: Stamp Mill
description: The Stamp Mill is a structure used to attach to a Smashing Plate allowing for powered automated mineral and rock production.

name: Stone Anvil
description: The Stone Anvil is a cold smithing structure used to shape Bronze Ingot or Iron Ingot into blades.

name: Tilled Field
description: A Tilled Field is a farm structure that's required for planting and growing crops. It has 20 slots that can be filled with the various crop types.

name: Trip Hammer
description: The Trip Hammer is a smithing powered structure used to automate and speed up the forging process.

name: Wind Mill
description: The Wind Mill is a simple structure for power generation that can be rotated to point in the direction of the wind.

name: Fort Banner (Hanging)
description: A Fort Banner (Hanging) is a banner that can be built to display your Empire's heraldry.

name: Fort Banner (Standing)
description: A Fort Banner (Standing) is a banner that can be built to display your Empire's heraldry.

name: Scorpion
description: The Scorpion is a defensive anti-infantry siege weapon that can be deployed on foundations. To operate it, Scorpion Arrows must be inserted into its inventory. Once loaded, the scorpion can be reloaded using the default key to prepare it to fire. A white tracer line will indicate your current aim.

name: Town Marketplace
description: A Town Marketplace is a structure for players to sell and buy armour, food, resources, tools, weapons, and vehicles. A market symbol can be seen on the map next to each Town which can be hovered to show the current buy and sell orders. For use the market must be visited in person and interacted with. The market has 3 menu tabs. "Buy/Sell" "Place Order" and "Active Orders. "Place Order" will only be shown if the market is interacted with directly.

name: Town Tavern
description: The Rested buff is a player buff that is applied boosting stamina regeneration for a set duration. The buff will be applied when eating any food within the interior of the Town Tavern.

name: Town Keep
description: The Town Keep is a preplaced structure that serves as a capture point for the military victory condition. It also acts as the primary spawn point for players, having a storage for 500 Auxiliary avatars and an additional 1000 for named avatars. The keep features a public storage armoury, which can be unlocked when enemies are nearby, as well as rentable house and private storages. It creates a buildable town area with a 120m radius, allowing for the construction of town structures, including foundations used for walls and defences. Town Keystones can be built by those with a house within this area, enabling the construction of more advanced smithing and cooking structures. For solo or newer players looking to live within a town it's advised that they rent a private storage tab, and make use of the towns services while also renting any town homesteads setup by others to fulfil any additional smithing or cooking needs that can't be met via the standard town services.
